entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Passion (Matthew 26:36 – 27:60 through this missal, which prints the older Passion from 26:1), revised against the Latin of the 1962 Missal in contemporary language: At that time (In illo témpore), the elders (senióres), righteous blood (sánguinem iustum), Jeremiah, Elijah and Caiaphas, tomb (monuméntum). Further contextual revisions express liability to death (Reus est mortis), identify the appraising agents (quem appretiaverunt a filiis Israel), and introduce the prophetic quotation as words spoken by the prophet (quod dictum est per Prophetam dicentem).
